g.title: j1057909280
g.text: Hey Aoi? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]

g.title: j3234663586
g.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.

g.title: j319849192
g.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.

g.title: j483206828
g.text: Nothing! Nothing. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.

g.title: j2977170771
g.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.

g.title: j2691570815
g.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.

g.title: j1212409669
g.text: i guess i just wanna know if i get 2 meet them or not?

g.title: j1027246209
g.text: oh... its not like... it's not 1 of the hex, is it? or one of the roundtable? that might get a little ick

g.title: j4286659563
g.text: No, you wouldn't know them. And sadly I don't know if I can arrange a meeting. They're not from this time.

g.title: j531824052
g.text: daangit!! well u have 2 promise me 2 have double the fun then on my account lol

g.title: j1010678023
g.text: but do they make u happy?

g.title: j2520738675
g.text: They do. And I don't care about you any less. You're both important to me.

g.title: j1608740547
g.text: then thats all i care about!

g.text: as long as we're all on the same page and every1 is happy with it, then i'm happy with it.
